anchor: Reported 9M2026 income and Sep balance sheet, Q4 estimated only. Opening gross loan proxy uses FY25 IFRS allowance ratio (51.60%); sensitivity uses 40%. 2025 recapitalization observed, no new equity in projections.

calibration.notes: Loan and placements yields, repricing share, slow reset and rate betas are explicit analyst assumptions. Starting securities and funding yields calibrated to annualized 9M2026 reported interest income/expense and FY25/Q3 mean stocks; earning cash fraction proxy FY25 net bank placements/aggregate cash. RWA proxy uses net loans at 100% + residual density calibrated to FY25 audited total RWA; actual Q3 numerator/RWA unavailable; separate gross loan anchor sensitivity does not alter opening net-loan RWA.

other.notes: Maintain stated capital70m, deposit for shares3425.621m and treasury shares-30m; no conversion/new injection assumed. Statutory reserve transfer 12.5% of positive FY26 cumulative PAT in Q4 (zero transfer YTD), then annual 12.5%, consistent with observed FY25; balance exceeds stated capital and no conversion assumed. No dividends in any case because accumulated deficit and recapitalization uncertainty; a distribution is not implied even if recovery clears deficit. Hold associate carrying value fixed; model separate associate income from Q3 run rate and GDP spread, not FY25 unusual 106.703m. Gross other operating expense before associates modeled separately. Tax effective 12–25% stress on positive incremental PBT; FY25 actual levies 10% and corporate tax zero, no future tax holiday asserted. Net loan RWA calibrated to audited FY25 total RWA; 80% profit eligibility and alternative RWA density +50% screens. Central bank share proxy 1332.726/3245.249, non-interest-bearing cash proxy 1-1509.928/3245.249. Neither is eligible reserve. 10% customer runoff at static other balance sheet, reduce reserve requirement on remaining deposits, no funding plug. Q3 cash includes bank balances; not unrestricted. FX no separate exposure extracted; no incremental FX P&L. Existing model assumes no future DDEP shock; loan NPL/allowance paths independent, no write-off claimed.
